title: Wristwatch Game Parts Catalog
description: JSON Schema Draft-07 for the Python-to-JS interop catalog artifact. Python (PARTS_CATALOG) is the sole producer; JavaScript is the sole consumer. See ADR-0001 and ADR-0003. Schema evolution policy: additive changes only — adding optional fields is non-breaking; adding new required fields or removing/renaming existing fields is a breaking change and REQUIRES a new ADR before the schema may be updated.

movements.description: List of movement family identifiers present in this catalog. Derived from the set of non-null movement_family values in the parts array.

parts.description: Ordered array of catalog part objects serialized from the Python PARTS_CATALOG.

Part.description: A single catalog part as serialized by the Python data layer.

name.description: Human-readable part name displayed to the player.

part_type.description: Part type classification (maps to PartType enum in part_compatibility.py).

movement_family.description: Movement family this part targets. null = universal (compatible with all families).

condition.description: Part condition (maps to PartCondition enum in part_compatibility.py).

price.description: Part price in game currency units.

function_description.description: Player-facing description of the part's mechanical function.
